error_policy.basis: Float32 operation reordering may produce small rounding differences; atol/rtol are predeclared diagnostic acceptance limits, not a proved error bound. Any rank change is reported and fails parity even when scores pass tolerance. Byte-exact scores reported separately; all element differences retained.
